Advances: specled.package

Follow-up from the specled_-48i test-quality gate (2026-07-26, epic specled_-233). None of these blocked that merge; all are latent robustness gaps in test/docs_concepts_content_lint_test.exs, which now backs specled.package.concepts_guide via the tagged_tests verification entry.

1. VACUOUS EMPTY-NEEDLE PASS — the important one, because it is this epic's own defect class one level down. assert_contains_all/3 passes when handed an EMPTY needle list. No call site does that today (all four clause groups are non-empty literals), but if a future edit accidentally empties a group, the clause silently loses its guard and the suite stays green. That is exactly the 'guard that cannot fail' shape specled_-48i was filed to eliminate, relocated into the helper. Fix: assert needles != [] inside the helper.

2. PADDING-COUPLED TABLE NEEDLES — the five realized_by tier needles embed exact interior column padding, so a purely cosmetic re-alignment of the docs/concepts.md table fails the lint with 'missing realized_by tiers content' for rows that are still present, reading as a deletion when it is a re-pad. Verified by experiment during verification: reformatting the table to single-space padding with ALL content preserved goes RED. Low probability (the repo has no markdown formatter — no prettier/markdownlint/mdformat/remark at root, in .github/workflows, in Makefile, or in .formatter.exs inputs), so nothing re-pads it unattended; it would take a human widening a column, e.g. adding a sixth tier with a longer name. Do NOT revert to bare backticked tier tokens — that was the original defect (they matched anywhere in the document). Fix options: match the backticked tier name and its prose fragment as two independent needles, collapse whitespace runs before comparing, or scope the search to the slice between '## The five tiers' and the next '## '.

3. FOUR CLAUSE GROUPS IN ONE test BLOCK — the first failing group raises, so a maintainer sees only one broken clause set per run. Four test blocks would report all four at once. test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs:298 already makes this argument for its own suite.

4. Minor: line 44 hardcodes the literal string 'docs/concepts.md' in the failure message while line 8 reads @concepts_path — same value today, will drift.

5. Minor: the async-safety argument for reading docs/concepts.md by RELATIVE path is non-local. It holds because the suite's only File.cd!/1 (test/specled_ex/realization/binding_test.exs:56) is in an async: false module and ExUnit never overlaps async with sync modules. A one-line comment mirroring test/specled_ex/review/coverage_closure_test.exs:23-26 would stop a future author breaking it from a distance.

6. Informational, no action implied: two needles in the graceful-degrade group are weakly anchored on their own — 'partial data.' occurs at docs/concepts.md:116 and :449, and detector_unavailable occurs 5 times. The group's unique anchors ('**Graceful degrade is first-class.**' :112, 'tier silently skips' :115) carry the check and whole-bullet deletion was proven to go RED, so nothing passes on the wrong occurrence. Relevant only if someone later trims that group.

Also noted during verification and deliberately left: the ASCII triangle diagram at docs/concepts.md:37-48 is unguarded (deleting all 12 diagram lines leaves the test green). The triangle clause is still load-bearing via its three section-unique side labels, so this is a narrowing opportunity, not a hole in the requirement.

All of items 1-5 remain. Single file to edit: test/docs_concepts_content_lint_test.exs.

1. In assert_contains_all/3 (line 40) add a non-vacuity guard as the first statement, e.g. `assert needles != [], "#{clause}: empty needle list — the clause guard is vacuous"`. End state: passing [] raises.

2. De-couple the five realized_by tier needles (lines 19-23) from table column padding. Pick one of: (a) scope the search to the slice of docs/concepts.md between "## The five tiers" (docs/concepts.md:85) and the next "## " heading ("## How a tier detects drift", docs/concepts.md:118) and assert backticked tier token + prose fragment as separate needles; (b) collapse whitespace runs (String.replace(~r/[ \t]+/, " ")) in BOTH haystack and needles before comparing. End state: re-padding docs/concepts.md:92-98 with content preserved stays GREEN, while deleting a tier row goes RED. Explicit constraint from the ticket: do NOT regress to bare backticked tier tokens as needles — they match anywhere in the document.

3. Split the one test at line 7 into four `test` blocks, one per clause group (spec triangle / realized_by tiers / graceful-degrade / intentional drift). Each MUST keep `@tag spec: "specled.package.concepts_guide"` or the tagged_tests verification entry at .spec/specs/package.spec.md:119-126 loses its binding for that requirement.

4. Replace the literal "docs/concepts.md" in the line-44 failure message with `#{@concepts_path}`.

5. Add a 3-4 line async-safety comment above `use ExUnit.Case, async: true` (line 2) mirroring test/specled_ex/review/coverage_closure_test.exs:23-26, explaining the relative-path read at line 8 is safe because the suite's only File.cd!/1 (test/specled_ex/realization/binding_test.exs:56) lives in an async: false module.

Item 6 in the ticket is explicitly informational (no action). The ASCII-triangle narrowing note at the end of the ticket is explicitly "deliberately left" — out of scope.

After editing: `mix format`, `mix test test/docs_concepts_content_lint_test.exs`, `mix spec.check --no-run-commands`.

- NO realization-hash risk. .spec/realization_hashes.json is keyed by MFA under tier buckets ("api_boundary" -> "Mix.Tasks.Spec.Check.run/1" -> hash); it contains zero occurrences of the string "package" and binds no test modules. Editing a test file cannot move a hash.
- NO spec-text change required. specled.package.concepts_guide's statement (.spec/specs/package.spec.md:109) is accurate and unchanged; this ticket is test-hardening only.
- Tagged-tests gate coupling: splitting into four tests (item 3) must preserve `@tag spec: "specled.package.concepts_guide"` on every new block, otherwise the `kind: tagged_tests / execute: true` entry at .spec/specs/package.spec.md:119-126 fails. That gate leg is known to be timing-flaky — re-run before debugging a first red.
- No ordering dependency on any other ticket in the set. specled_-4pl and specled_-ozm also carry `Advances: specled.package` and both edit test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs; yds only READS that file (line 298 cited as precedent) and never edits it, so no file+region collision. No ticket in the set names docs/concepts.md or test/docs_concepts_content_lint_test.exs (grepped all 21).
- Item 2 changes the failure mode of a lint backing a must-priority requirement; include a red-proof in the commit message (delete a tier row -> RED) so the "fix" does not itself become a weaker guard.

SCOPE CONTRACT (orchestrator, specled_-k6s — 2026-07-27)

Authoritative for mechanical scope checks. Supplements, does not replace, the
ADMISSION VERIFICATION comment's mandate (items 1-5), which is what you implement.

## Allowed touches
- `test/docs_concepts_content_lint_test.exs` — and nothing else. ONE-FILE diff.

## Out of Scope (files)
- `docs/concepts.md` — you may READ it (item 2 scopes the search to a slice of
  it) and you will temporarily mutate a copy or the file itself to prove RED,
  but the committed diff must not contain it.
- `test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs` — cited only as precedent. Read, do not edit.
  specled_-4pl and specled_-ozm own that file.
- `.spec/specs/package.spec.md` — no spec-text change is required; the
  `concepts_guide` statement is accurate. Do not edit it.
- `CHANGELOG.md` (orchestrator consolidates once at the end), `VERSION`,
  `.spec/realization_hashes.json`, `.spec/state.json`.
- Every file not listed under Allowed touches.

## Out of Scope (intent)
- Item 6 of the ticket is INFORMATIONAL — no action. The ASCII-triangle narrowing
  note at the end of the ticket is explicitly "deliberately left" — out of scope.
- Item 3 splits one test into four. EVERY new block MUST keep
  `@tag spec: "specled.package.concepts_guide"`, or the `tagged_tests`
  verification entry loses its binding and the gate goes red.
- Item 2 explicitly forbids regressing to bare backticked tier tokens as
  needles — they match anywhere in the document.
- No new dependencies.

## FALSIFIABILITY BAR — this ticket is one of the five the epic gates on
This ticket changes the failure mode of a lint backing a must-priority
requirement. A "fix" that makes the guard weaker is the exact defect. You must
prove BOTH directions for item 2:
1. RE-PAD the table at `docs/concepts.md` (~:92-98) with content preserved →
   the test must stay GREEN.
2. DELETE a tier row from that table → the test must go RED.
3. Revert `docs/concepts.md` to its committed state.
And for item 1: passing `[]` to `assert_contains_all/3` must RAISE.
Paste both outputs into your completion record and record the mutations and
their reverts in the COMMIT MESSAGE. "Tests pass" is not evidence here.

## Verification (change-scoped, run-until-green; host mix, no compose)
1. `mix format`
2. `mix compile --warnings-as-errors`
3. `mix test test/docs_concepts_content_lint_test.exs`
4. `mix format --check-formatted`
5. `mix spec.check --no-run-commands`
6. `git diff --name-only` must be exactly `test/docs_concepts_content_lint_test.exs`.

Do NOT run bare `mix spec.check` and do NOT run the full suite. The orchestrator
owns whole-system proof at the merge gate and PR CI.

- (b) Tags verified byte-exact, not eyeballed. `grep -c -F` on the full literal `  @tag spec: "specled.package.concepts_guide"` returns 4, and there are exactly 4 `@tag` lines total (:11, :23, :41, :53) and exactly 4 `test` blocks -- one tag per block, no unmatched or typo'd variant. Subject id matches .spec/specs/package.spec.md:108 and is listed under the `kind: tagged_tests` verification `covers:` at package.spec.md:126.

- (c) Empty-needle guard is the FIRST statement of assert_contains_all/3 (:65), before the collapse rebinds `content`/`needles`. Verified it actually raises, and verified its position: I called the helper with `content = nil` and `needles = []` in an out-of-tree ExUnit probe. If the guard were reordered after collapse_ws/1, nil would blow up in String.replace/3 first; instead it raised ExUnit.AssertionError with "clause: empty needle list -- the clause guard is vacuous". No earlier early-return exists to bypass it.

- (d) No assertion lost in the 1-to-4 split. Extracted every `assert_contains_all(concepts, ...)` call line plus every needle literal from base 2023373d and from HEAD and diffed them: 21 lines each, byte-identical. All four clause groups (spec triangle, realized_by tiers, graceful-degrade, intentional drift) and all 17 needles survive verbatim; each now lives in its own test.

- (e) The async-safety comment claim (:2-6) is TRUE. `grep -rn "set_cwd\|File\.cd"` across all *.ex/*.exs outside deps/ and _build/ finds exactly one call site: test/specled_ex/realization/binding_test.exs:56 and :62 (cd and restore). That module is `use ExUnit.Case, async: false` at binding_test.exs:3. No `:file.set_cwd` anywhere. ExUnit runs all async modules to completion before sync modules, so no overlap. The comment also matches an existing repo convention -- test/specled_ex/review/coverage_closure_test.exs:24 and test/mix/tasks/spec_check_test.exs:141 carry the same style of note.

- (f) No Process.sleep, no spawn/Task.async, no unmanaged processes, no tmp_dir or shared-path usage in the touched file. Nothing to clean up between tests; four independent File.read!/1 calls keep the tests isolated (correct here -- ETC-ORG-004 prefers inlining over a setup block at this size).

- (item 4) Failure message now interpolates `#{@concepts_path}` at :72 instead of the literal. Confirmed.

- Optional, non-blocking: the vacuity guard catches `[]` but not a needle list containing an empty string, since String.contains?(x, "") is always true. If you want the guard airtight, `assert needles != [] and Enum.all?(needles, &(&1 != ""))`. Out of scope for this ticket. Also unrelated: the worktree has an untracked .grok/sandbox.toml -- not part of this change.
